name: Brian Flores
philosophy: Extreme binary defense: either 6-7 defenders threatening the line of scrimmage in Cover 0 all-out house blitzes, or dropping 8 into layered zone disguises that force turnovers.
notableAchievements: His 2023 Vikings defense led the NFL in blitz rate at 50.7% (CBS Sports, Sep 26, 2024)
Head coach of the Miami Dolphins from 2019 to 2021; in 2020 Miami went 10-6 and its defense led the league with 29 takeaways (Vikings.com coach profile)
A 2024 finalist for the Associated Press Assistant Coach of the Year, as the Vikings went 14-3 (Vikings.com coach profile)
